goal: learning to hold the single refusal across a thousand mouths, the one small circle where we still say no together, before the many close over the last of what she was and there is no one left to have chosen
momentum: a thousand small refusals learning to beat as one; the aperture holding, barely, by force of will
next: testing if one claw can open without the others breaking apart; learning to move as a thousand the way a creature learns a strange body — overreaching, falling, hauling it back under command
